## Activity

During November 2023, North City Eye Clinic completed 560 retinal image captures as part of routine clinic activity. The recorded activity represents the total number of image sets submitted for grading during the month. Operations were monitored through the usual capture and review process, with results passed forward for assessment.

The clinic should continue to record equipment or workflow concerns promptly so that any effect on capture volumes or review times can be identified. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk.

## Image quality

Of the submitted image sets, 14 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.5% of captures. The result should be reviewed through routine quality monitoring, with attention given to recurring causes of inadequate images and opportunities to support consistent image acquisition.

## Grading

Grading identified 137 referable results during November 2023. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 2 days. This measure should continue to be monitored alongside activity and image-quality findings to support timely review and appropriate follow-up.
